name: dumbbell cossack squats
description: A side-to-side squat that trains the legs and loads the inner thighs through a big range of motion.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with a wide stance.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Sit deep with your chest up and the straight leg's toes pointing up.
Push through the bent leg to return to the center.
